claim_policy.pollution_rule: 1-min load > pollute_load or a foreign process > 60% CPU in 2 consecutive samples = POLLUTED

mlx-vlm.prefix_cache: no cross-request reuse (0% cached in replay)

mlx-lm.prefix_cache: yes, default in-memory LRU prompt cache
mlx-lm.cache_hits_visible_via: usage.prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens; server log 'Prompt Cache: N sequences, X GB'

omlx.mtp: no (MTP needs oMLX's own checkpoint; stock weights have no MTP head)
omlx.prefix_cache: yes, default paged SSD prefix cache under the scratch HOME (fresh per session, so no cross-session hits)
omlx.cache_hits_visible_via: usage.prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens (reported after warm-up; first rows can be unknown)
omlx.own_memory_guard: process memory enforcer (tier balanced, ceiling ~54-56 GB): aborts requests and unloads the model
omlx.flags: serve --model-dir <scratch>/models (symlink to models/qwen38-4bit) --port 8653, HOME=<scratch>/home, defaults otherwise (memory-guard balanced, max-concurrent-requests 8)
